title: Make security discovery and confirmation uncertainty explicit
problem: Malformed security answers can become empty results or negative confirmations.
hypothesis: A strict discovery schema and supported/refuted/uncertain/error ledger preserve candidates without claiming unsupported confirmation.
why_build: Direct synthetic witness demonstrates another false-clean path; honest security assessment fits existing repository priorities.
why_not_build: Requires explicit security verdict and fail-on/incomplete policy across engines, reporters and consumers. Not treated as the scanner fix or silently promoted into implementation.
decision: Pending human agreement on confirmation semantics and consumer failure behavior.
counter_evidence: Thrown exceptions already preserve findings; explicit true/false answers are supported. Existing research qualifies hardening as partial.
next_validation: Require malformed/refused/partial answers to preserve candidates, expose uncertainty and never assert confirmed; test all engine profiles.

title: Establish trusted security tool and resource boundaries
problem: Security CLI fallback and Semgrep still lack verified executable/config/resource provenance and full isolation guarantees.
hypothesis: An agreed credential/filesystem/network and trusted-binary/config policy can bound untrusted analysis execution.
why_build: Read-only untrusted review is an explicit security requirement; source establishes inconsistent guarantees.
why_not_build: Architecture/security decision, not a narrow safe automation edit. No exploit execution, production incidence or complete sandbox validation exists.
decision: Pending human trust/sandbox policy; no execution-policy changes authorized by this finding.
counter_evidence: Normal Pi restricts tools/resource discovery and uses an allowlisted environment; configured API keys take HTTP instead of fallback; prelint rejects workspace binaries by default.
next_validation: Agree trusted resources and egress/credential bounds; run harmless adversarial fixtures in a credential-free isolated environment.

title: Triage transitive production advisories before choosing an upgrade
problem: Production audit lists 15 advisories, including 3 high WebSocket-related Undici entries, without verified action-path exploit reachability.
hypothesis: Call-path analysis and compatible upstream upgrade tests identify a bounded upgrade instead of an unsafe major override.
why_build: Advisory presence is directly observed in production dependencies; risk reduction fits runtime reliability.
why_not_build: Presence is not exploitation; high advisories involve APIs not established in this action. Major package upgrades/overrides may change Octokit/HTTP contracts.
decision: No dependency edits this run; investigate reachability and compatible upgrade separately.
counter_evidence: Frozen consumer tests and current runtime tests pass; no WebSocket use was established in action source.
next_validation: Map advisory API to shipped bundle usage, then test a supported upstream upgrade on Node 24 and both action contracts.

title: Verify canary and rollback before changing consumer refs
problem: Main consumers, latest release/tag, package version and changelog differ; no tested rollback procedure or named canary is documented.
hypothesis: A named trusted canary, immutable action ref and tested rollback/readiness procedure permit measurable compatible rollout.
why_build: Standing release authorization explicitly requires verified rollout, health and rollback; merge to main can affect existing consumers.
why_not_build: No authority to invent production consumers, move existing tags, manufacture health telemetry or assume a rollback command is tested.
decision: Merge/release BLOCKED until verified canary/rollback evidence is supplied or established within scope. Do not change CI, protection or consumer repositories.
counter_evidence: GitHub Action has no long-running service or migration; previous PR review workflows succeeded. This does not prove zero consumer impact or rollback readiness.
next_validation: Select authorized canary and prior known-good immutable ref; test rollback and critical consumer journeys with secrets isolated from untrusted code.
